pages.text: This armour set is fire retardant. When wearing a full set of fire retardant armour, if the player is then lit on fire, the fire is immeditaly extinguished as long as they are not still within a source of fire$(br2)For example, if a player was wearing a full fire retardant armour set and standing in fire, they would stay on fire like normal; However the moment the player steps out from the fire, the fire is extinguished on the player.
